# engine_claiming_specs_baseline.txt — PRE-EXISTING debt, not approval.
# Each entry is a spec whose describe/it titles claim JIT / native / codegen /
# AOT behaviour while its body physically runs on the tree-walking interpreter,
# so it stays green through a full reintroduction of the defect it names.
# Generated by: sh scripts/check/check-engine-claiming-specs-use-probe.shs --update-baseline
# REMOVING a line is how debt is retired (convert it to an engine probe, rename
# the titles, or add '# @engine-reach: interpreter-only — <reason>').
# ADDING a line must be justified in the same commit — that review checkpoint is
# the entire point of this guard. Do not run --update-baseline to silence a new
# failure.
